eval.*.date.means: the day the clip was scored

eval.*.engine.means: the last commit that changed the engine it scored

eval.*.scored_s.means: the part of the clip that is scored

eval.*.tolerance_s.means: how far a candidate may be from its label and still match

eval.*.truth.*.means: labelled events of this kind in the scored part

eval.*.fps_*.person_ids.means: distinct person track ids at this rate (fewer is steadier)

eval.*.fps_*.motion_alarm_alerts.means: alerts a plain motion alarm sends

eval.*.fps_*.ai.checks.means: AI checks the app would make (after dedupe and incidents)

eval.*.fps_*.ai.per_camera_hour.means: AI checks per camera hour on this clip

eval.*.fps_*.all.precision_ci.means: precision's Wilson 95% interval, every watch together

eval.*.fps_*.all.recall_ci.means: recall's Wilson 95% interval, every watch together

eval.*.fps_*.all.recall_failures_at_most.means: with no miss, the rule of three bound on the miss rate, every watch together

eval.*.fps_*.all.precision_failures_at_m.means: with no false alarm, the rule of three bound on the false alarm share, every watch together

eval.*.fps_*.all.false_alarms_per_hour.means: false alarms per camera hour, every watch together

eval.*.fps_*.*.recall_failures_at_most.means: with no miss, the rule of three bound on the miss rate, this watch

eval.*.fps_*.*.precision_failures_at_mos.means: with no false alarm, the rule of three bound on the false alarm share, this watch

eval.*.fps_*.*.false_alarms_per_hour.means: false alarms per camera hour, this watch

eval.*.fps_*.*.fired.means: candidates this watch raised in the scored part

eval.*.fps_*.*.delay_median.means: median time from the labelled moment to the candidate

eval.*.fps_*.*.delay_p90.means: 90th percentile time from the labelled moment to the candidate

eval.*.fps_*.*.first_false_alarm_at.means: when the first false alarm came (its picture is in eval/results/failures)

eval.*.fps_*.*.first_miss_at.means: when the first missed event was (its picture is in eval/results/failures)

bench.*.instance.means: the AWS instance type it ran on (none on the dev box)

bench.*.engine.means: the last commit that changed the engine it measured

bench.*.fps_per_camera.means: analysed frames a second per camera, median

bench.*.fps_per_camera_min.means: analysed frames a second of the slowest camera

bench.*.fps_total.means: analysed frames a second, every camera together

bench.*.fps_per_vcpu.means: analysed frames a second per vCPU

bench.*.fps_per_cpu_used.means: analysed frames a second per CPU the run actually got

bench.*.latency_p50.means: frame latency median (frame in to rules done)

bench.*.memory_total.means: memory of the app and every process it started, median

bench.*.memory_peak.means: the same, its peak over the whole run

bench.*.cameras_at_2fps.means: cameras this machine can give 2 analysed frames a second

bench.*.cameras_at_5fps.means: cameras this machine can give 5 analysed frames a second

bench.*.host_load.means: the host's 1 minute load during the run, median

bench.*.throttled_s.means: time the container's CPU quota held the run back

bench.*.ai_checks_per_camera_hour.means: AI checks per camera hour in the run

bench.*.cost.*.at_2fps.cameras.means: cameras one instance takes at 2 analysed frames a second, from this run's rate per vCPU

bench.*.cost.*.at_2fps.inr.means: compute cost per camera a month at 2 frames a second, in rupees

bench.*.cost.*.at_2fps.usd.means: compute cost per camera a month at 2 frames a second, in dollars

bench.*.cost.*.at_2fps.measured.means: whether the run was on that instance (else this machine's rate applied to it)

bench.*.cost.*.at_5fps.cameras.means: cameras one instance takes at 5 analysed frames a second, from this run's rate per vCPU

bench.*.cost.*.at_5fps.inr.means: compute cost per camera a month at 5 frames a second, in rupees

bench.*.cost.*.at_5fps.usd.means: compute cost per camera a month at 5 frames a second, in dollars

bench.*.cost.*.at_5fps.measured.means: whether the run was on that instance (else this machine's rate applied to it)

bench.*.confirm.fps_min.means: the slowest camera's analysed frames a second in the confirming run

bench.*.confirm.meets_2fps.means: whether every camera got 2 frames a second in the confirming run

bench.speedup.cool_over_stock.means: COOL's throughput over stock OpenCV's on the same Graviton instance

bench.speedup.graviton_over_x86.means: c8g with COOL over c7i with stock OpenCV, same size

plates.*.outside_grammar.means: plates outside the grammar (old or special)

plates.*.outside_grammar_unread.means: of those, left unread as they should be

plates.*.colour_photos.means: photos with a known plate colour

plans.free.cameras.means: watched cameras in the free plan

plans.society.cameras.means: watched cameras in the society plan

plans.society.month_usd.means: the society plan a month in dollars, about

bench.speedup.cool_over_stock_no_text.means: COOL over stock OpenCV on the same Graviton instance, without the description watch

bench.speedup.graviton_over_x86_no_text.means: c8g with COOL over c7i with stock OpenCV, same size, without the description watch

eval.*.fps_*.analysis_fps.means: the analysis rate of this run

eval.*.cpu.means: the CPU that scored the clip

eval.*.opencv.means: the OpenCV version that scored the clip

eval.*.cool.means: whether the clip was scored with COOL's OpenCV

bench.*.kleidicv.means: whether KleidiCV was in the OpenCV build it loaded

bench.*.index.means: whether the search index was on

plans.free.days.means: days the free plan keeps footage

plans.society.days.means: days the society plan keeps footage

plans.free.ai_checks.means: AI checks a day for a free society

plans.society.ai_checks.means: AI checks a day per watched camera on the society plan

plans.free.staff.means: staff a free society may enrol

plans.society.staff.means: staff a society on the paid plan may enrol

plans.large.min_cameras.means: cameras from which a site is a large site

plans.refund_days.means: days in which a yearly plan can be refunded in full

plans.society.year_usd.means: the society plan a year in dollars, about

aws.instance_type.means: EC2 instance type of the deploy

aws.url.means: the public address of the deploy

aws.opencv.means: OpenCV version deploy/cv2_info.py printed on the instance

aws.cv2_file.means: the cv2 module file deploy/cv2_info.py printed on the instance

aws.cool.means: cv2 loaded from under /opt/cool: the proof that COOL runs

aws.kleidicv.means: KleidiCV in the loaded OpenCV build, from deploy/cv2_info.py

aws.healthz_opencv.means: the OpenCV version the running app reported on /healthz

aws.healthz_kleidicv.means: KleidiCV in the running app's OpenCV, from /healthz

aws.worker_beat.means: the job worker's heartbeat was fresh at the end of the deploy

aws.memory_budget_mb.means: the memory budget deploy/check_memory.py checked against

aws.memory_ok.means: whether the instance was inside its memory budget

cost.aws_month_inr.means: the estimated AWS cost a month in rupees, at the plans file's rate

agent.*.model.means: the AI provider and model of the trace

agent.*.moment_s.means: the flagged moment's time in the clip

agent.*.dark.means: the share of brightness the frames kept

agent.*.runs.means: AI checks run on the moment

agent.*.r*.verdict.means: the verifier's verdict on that run

agent.*.r*.tools.means: the steps the model took, in order

agent.*.r*.s*.why.means: the model's reason for that step

agent.*.r*.s*.ms.means: that step's time, the model's reply included

agent.*.r*.reason.means: the model's reason for its grade
